uncited: CoDeF (Computational Deformation Field) is a deformation representation used within Neural and primitive-based representations for dynamic volume rendering, specifically in the context of 4D Gaussian Splatting [14869-codef.md].
It models temporal motion by mapping points from a canonical space to a deformed space using a multiresolution hash table [14869-codef.md].

It sets itself apart from sibling methods like [Multi-MLP Linear Layer](15116-multi-mlp-linear-layer.md) by relying on hash-grid-based deformation rather than explicit MLP parameterizations or latent code conditioning, prioritizing storage efficiency and compatibility with standard image processing pipelines [14869-codef.md].
